title: ArcCivs repair of an open warehouse annex inside its existing paid bounds
assumptions: One owner-authorized repair of an existing paid warehouse, not ordinary worker construction or a repeatable reward.
All three scenarios assume one repair; they are not measured player throughput.
Proposed authored shell adds323 world cells inside23x7x5: exact per-material map is separate from item inventory. Fresh native preview must verify exclusions and exact changes before apply.
Existing thirteen source container blocks plus any current relocated control, their real inventories and lids are preserved. No extra container is created.
No Native material grant, inventory debit, refund, Stock, resident cycle, worker credit, skill or player XP flow. A typed existing world-change journal owns exact capture, CAS, replay and rollback.

Both confirmed annex families were already excluded from fresh autonomous standalone selection; accepted source lookup and old plan replay remain available. Existing prices, rates and ordinary construction bills are unchanged.
Current SELL and future SELL-to-contract flows remain separate and unchanged. No value or exchange rate is assigned to world blocks.
Source rendering, native preview/apply, disk runtime version and ordinary client acceptance are independent evidence.
